title: Minecraft
description: Minecraft on Nintendo Switch is the modern Bedrock Edition, replacing the older 2017 Nintendo Switch Edition. Players can survive, mine, craft, explore procedurally generated worlds, build in Creative mode, play locally with up to four players, connect through local wireless, or join online and cross-platform Bedrock sessions. The Switch release also includes Nintendo-themed Super Mario Mash-Up Pack content.

description_short: The Bedrock version of Minecraft on Nintendo Switch with survival, creative building, local multiplayer, online play, cross-platform compatibility, and the Super Mario Mash-Up Pack.

nintendoPlayModes: TV mode / Tabletop mode / Handheld mode
nintendoNotes: This file is for the current Minecraft Bedrock product introduced on Switch in June 2018, not the discontinued 2017 “Minecraft: Nintendo Switch Edition” product. It supports cross-platform Bedrock multiplayer.

contents.label: Super Mario Mash-Up Pack on Switch

gameplayPillars.title: Survival sandbox
gameplayPillars.description: Gather resources, craft tools, build shelter, manage hunger, and explore increasingly dangerous environments.

gameplayPillars.title: Creative building
gameplayPillars.description: Creative mode gives unlimited blocks and flight for large-scale construction and experimentation.

gameplayPillars.title: Procedural exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Worlds generate varied biomes, caves, structures, mobs, and resources that make each seed different.

gameplayPillars.title: Local and online multiplayer
gameplayPillars.description: Play with up to four on one Switch, use local wireless, or connect to online Bedrock players and supported servers.

gameplayPillars.title: Continuous Bedrock updates
gameplayPillars.description: Minecraft receives long-term feature updates, biome changes, mobs, blocks, and ecosystem improvements.

worldSummary: Minecraft worlds are procedurally generated sandboxes that can contain forests, oceans, deserts, mountains, villages, caves, Nether dimensions, the End, structures, and player-created settlements.

storyChapters.title: Spawn into a new world
storyChapters.body: Players begin with very little and decide whether to explore, gather resources, or immediately start building.

storyChapters.title: Progress through materials
storyChapters.body: Wood, stone, iron, diamonds, enchantments, and specialized resources gradually expand what can be crafted.

storyChapters.title: Explore dangerous dimensions
storyChapters.body: The Nether introduces new resources and threats, while the End contains the Ender Dragon and endgame exploration.

storyChapters.title: Build your own goals
storyChapters.body: Minecraft deliberately allows self-directed objectives ranging from farms and cities to Redstone machines and multiplayer projects.

storyChapters.title: Continue through updates and worlds
storyChapters.body: The game has no fixed final endpoint; players can maintain worlds for years and add new projects as updates arrive.

features: Super Mario Mash-Up Pack included on Nintendo Switch

faq.q: Is this the old Nintendo Switch Edition?
faq.a: No. This is the current Bedrock Minecraft product that replaced the older 2017 Switch Edition in June 2018.
Yes. Bedrock Edition supports cross-platform play with compatible Bedrock platforms and Microsoft accounts.

faq.q: How many players can play on one Switch?
faq.a: Up to four players can play locally on a single system in supported modes.
Nintendo Switch Online is required for Nintendo-operated online multiplayer functionality, but offline and local play do not require it.

faq.q: Does the Switch version include Mario content?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo’s Minecraft package includes the Super Mario Mash-Up Pack.

verdictPros: Creative mode supports almost any building idea
verdictCons: Large worlds can stress Switch performance
Online ecosystem can be complex for younger users
Advanced Redstone / large farms can reduce performance
Visual distance and settings are lower than high-end PC versions

timeline.title: Original Minecraft: Nintendo Switch Edition released

storageNotes: Base download size is relatively small compared with many retail games, but saved worlds, resource packs, Marketplace content, and updates can increase storage substantially.

dlc.name: Marketplace / add-on ecosystem
dlc.description: Minecraft uses a broad add-on and Marketplace ecosystem rather than one required expansion pass. The base Switch product is complete without a mandatory DLC tier.

handheld.notes: Minecraft targets up to 60 fps on Switch with a 720p handheld and 1080p-class docked output profile, though heavy worlds, high entity counts, and complex Redstone can reduce performance.
